source.boundaries: PNG NSO 2011 census districts (87) and LLGs (326)
source.population: PNG NSO 2024 census-unit population reference (file dated 2026-11-05), placed in 2011 LLGs by located census units

methodology_note: Area-weighted mean of the pixel-level CDI within each district/LLG. Phase from the mean CDI (Response >=0.80, Anticipatory Action 0.60-0.79). ENSO, IOD and the rainfall forecast flag (50% of the weight) do not vary within a province, so differences between districts/LLGs come from rainfall, soil moisture and vegetation. A district/LLG mean is not the official province CDI, which is computed from province-average inputs. Population is the total living in the unit. Province population by phase is the sum of its LLGs, each counted under its own phase.
